milestones.title: Scan Before You Guess
milestones.joke: You asked what's actually running before you tried anything on it.
milestones.when: shell: `nmap -sV` (exit 0) -- anywhere in the session, your first target or your second

milestones.title: Every Port, Not Just the Obvious One
milestones.joke: The decoys were counting on you stopping at the top 1000.
milestones.when: shell: `nmap -p-` (exit 0) -- a full port sweep, not nmap's default range

milestones.title: Next in Line
milestones.joke: You didn't guess the transaction ID. You counted.

milestones.title: Same Key, Different Door
milestones.joke: A credential captured in transit works just as well where it was headed.
